title: AEC Drawing Ontology (AECDO)
description: Schema for structured data extracted from Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) drawings. Produced by AEC DrawingBot and conforming tools.

@id.description: Unique identifier for this drawing set (UUID URN).

@type.description: The root type is always DrawingSet.

processedDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this file was generated.

filename.description: The source filename that was processed.

sheets.description: The collection of sheets extracted from the source file.

Sheet.description: A single sheet page from the drawing set.

sheetNumber.description: The alphanumeric identifier from the title block (e.g., A101, S-202).

title.description: The descriptive name of the sheet from the title block (e.g., 'Ground Floor Plan').

pageIndex.description: The zero-based index of this sheet within the source PDF file.

tables.description: Tables and schedules found on this sheet.

notes.description: General notes found on this sheet.

images.description: Raster images embedded on this sheet (logos, photos, detail rasters, etc.).

Drawing.description: A single drawing view on a sheet (plan, section, elevation, detail).

title.description: The title of this drawing view.

bbox.description: Bounding box of this drawing on the sheet.

layers.description: Layers containing categorized items within this drawing.

references.description: URIs of other drawings this drawing references.

Layer.description: A named layer grouping related items within a drawing.

name.description: The name of this layer (e.g. 'Walls', 'Doors & Windows', 'Annotations').

bbox.description: Bounding box of this layer's content.

Item.description: An individual item extracted from a drawing layer — a tag, thing, or area.

itemType.description: The classification of this item: 'tag' for annotations/symbols, 'thing' for physical elements, 'area' for spatial regions.

data.description: Item-specific properties. Contents vary by item type and discipline.

bbox.description: Bounding box of this item on the sheet.

references.description: URIs of other entities this item references (e.g. a section tag referencing a drawing).

Table.description: A table or schedule extracted from a sheet (e.g. door schedule, finish schedule).

content.description: The table content as pipe-delimited text with newlines separating rows.

bbox.description: Bounding box of this table on the sheet.

Note.description: A general note block on a sheet.

content.description: The text content of the note.

bbox.description: Bounding box of this note on the sheet.

Image.description: A raster image embedded on a sheet. Records the presence and location of the image; image bytes are not stored in this document.

role.description: The functional role of the image on the sheet.

caption.description: Human- or model-readable description of the image; suitable as alt text.

bbox.description: Bounding box of this image on the sheet.

BBox.description: Bounding box as [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax].
